title: vincetoxicum luteum
intro: Vincetoxicum luteum, commonly known as Yellow Milk Vetch, is a species of flowering plant in the family Apocynaceae. It has been traditionally used in medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties, making it useful in treating various conditions such as fever, sore throat, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Vincetoxicum luteum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which exhibit antioxidant, anti-cancer, and immune-modulating effects. The plant's bioactive constituents also include vincetoxin and roemerine, which have been shown to have anti-tumor and anti-inflammatory activities.
